profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ HCL Technologies | IBM Infosphere Advanced DataStage
profile.summary:
Currently serving as a Senior Software Engineer at HCL Technologies, I specialize in data engineering and ETL tools with a focus on delivering high-quality solutions for a US-based banking client. My role involves developing and maintaining ETL code using DataStage, DBT models, and Shell scripts while leveraging databases like Snowflake, Hadoop, and Oracle to drive efficient data processes.  

With over three years of experience in data engineering at HCL Technologies, I am committed to fostering teamwork and creating scalable solutions that align with business needs. My work is centered on supporting organizational goals through innovative approaches and collaborative efforts, contributing to the success of the projects I am a part of.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Joined the biggest HCL Project, where we develop ETL/Shell software for one of the most important banks in the United States. Besides my responsibilities with my client, I also help HCL filtering out DataStage candidates, as well as training my co-workers.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analytics · Problem Solving · Shell Scripting · Data Mapping · Analytics · Business Requirements · Computer Science · Data Manipulation · Collaborative Problem Solving · ETL Tools · Requirements Gathering · Teamwork · Data Engineering · Business Rules · Communication · Technical Design

positions.title: Senior ETL Consultant
positions.description: Joined the MIT project, we’re in charge of redesigning the current retirement program in Mexico (for one of the insurances in the country) to newer technologies. Despite being ETL, I also take care of the Database activities and QA/Integration testing for our team.
positions.insights: Skills: Data Analytics · Problem Solving · Shell Scripting · Data Mapping · Analytics · Business Requirements · Computer Science · Data Manipulation · Collaborative Problem Solving · ETL Tools · Requirements Gathering · Teamwork · Data Engineering · Business Rules · Communication · Technical Design

positions.title: Senior Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Continued the Global Workforce Management project, but not only by feeding the third-party tool, but also by designing new and better solutions, being more involved with the market to understand what they really need, and not only in the DataStage-related (9.1) logic, but also in different technologies, such as Apache Kafka/Storm.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Joined the Global Workforce Management project. It consists on feeding a third-party app by exploiting Wal-Mart’s HR Databases (DataStage 8.1 & 9.1), applying complex business rules to the information, and sending it so the tool would be able to absorb it and forecast schedules for stores worldwide.

positions.title: ETL Consultant
positions.description: Started off as a trainee for 3 months, but I quickly grew as a developer/consultant, to the point of leading my own technical team from getting business requirements to designing the DataStage (7.5.6 & 8.7) solutions for our client (SAT).
